tasks.short: Collaborate on congregational finance and administration

steps.what: Prepare relevant financial or administrative information for committee discussion
Collaborate with committees or individuals to address financial or administrative issues

tasks.design: Use native {ERP} reports and a {DOCS} agenda template to assemble existing information. The clergy member verifies period and relevance and retains the entire discussion; the committee's financial authority is unchanged.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated copying of established reports into meeting packs.
tasks.enabler_now: Native report views and document links can reuse existing figures.
tasks.still_hard: Financial choices involve priorities, trust and constraints beyond the figures.
tasks.human_edge: Explain the pastoral consequences of an administrative choice.
tasks.altitude: Less pack assembly with unchanged committee participation and authority.

reach.task: Clarify a financial assumption before committee discussion
reach.learn: Reporting periods, restricted funds and unresolved liabilities

evidence.claim: DocBase with Exact Online supports parish financial and member administration; that supports availability of records, not automated committee decisions.
Native report reuse may reduce pack assembly; the proposed saving is unmeasured.

assumptions: Boundary is clergy preparation and collaboration, excluding treasurer bookkeeping, committee members' time and execution of decisions.

Treasurer produces existing reports through the unchanged accounting process. Clergy selects report version, period, agenda issue and permitted audience in s1; selection, capture and verification remain within its 60% time. Missing figures are clarified manually, never inferred.
Test native reports before custom code. Member and donor details are excluded unless necessary and authorised; no automatic spending decision or runtime saving.
research_questions: Does linked report reuse save preparation after period and access checks?

already_counted.description: Select reports and verify pack relevance and access

incremental.description: Maintain report links and pack template

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=92; gross 8 less upkeep 2 gives net 6. High assumes repeated report copying; low assumes unresolved figures consume the gain. Collaboration retains 80 hours.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Organise and join community and interfaith activities

steps.what: Agree activity purpose, partners and practical needs through community discussion
Coordinate rooms, dates, resources and participant information for the activity
Engage in the activity and respond to participants and partners

tasks.design: Configure shared booking views and standard arrangement checklists in {CALENDAR} and {DOCS}. The clergy member retains purpose-setting, partner conversations, final arrangements and actual participation; no public invitation or partner commitment is sent automatically.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated coordination messages about established dates, rooms and resources.
tasks.enabler_now: Native booking views can show existing availability and retain checklist details.
tasks.still_hard: Interfaith sensitivities and participant needs require negotiation and personal attention.
tasks.human_edge: Create a respectful activity that different communities can join willingly.
tasks.altitude: Less repetitive logistics with unchanged relationships and participation.

reach.task: Resolve venue and access needs for a joint event
reach.learn: Inclusive arrangements and clear partner commitments

evidence.claim: Shared booking views and arrangement checklists can reduce repetitive coordination while preserving partner agreement.

assumptions: Boundary is clergy organisation and participation, excluding partner effort, venue operation and mass publicity. Those activities remain with their existing owners.

Clergy produces date options, location needs, resource list and agreed purpose in s1 with full time retained. Venue and partners supply their existing availability; clergy captures and confirms the selected details in retained s2 time. Missing availability requires manual contact, not assumed confirmation.
Test native calendar configuration first. No new personal registration dataset is required; no inferred religious affiliation or runtime saving.
research_questions: Do booking views reduce coordination after partner confirmation and access checks?

already_counted.description: Capture arrangements, confirm partners and resolve booking exceptions

incremental.description: Maintain booking permissions and arrangement checklist

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=90; gross 10 less upkeep 2 gives net 8. High assumes routine logistical exchanges; low assumes partner negotiation consumes the gain. Purpose discussions and participation retain 75 hours.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Oversee buildings, purchasing and staff or volunteers

steps.what: Inspect building needs and gather supply or repair requirements
Prepare supply orders, service requests and repair contracting documents
Check authority and terms and place authorised orders or service contracts
Supervise staff or volunteers and follow up building and service work

tasks.design: Use native purchasing forms in {PROCUREMENT} and checked templates in {DOCS} to prepare routine supply and service documents. The clergy member retains site checks, terms review, orders within delegation and all staff or volunteer supervision.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated entry of routine supplier and requirement details.
tasks.enabler_now: Saved forms can reuse existing supplier details without making purchasing decisions.
tasks.still_hard: Repair suitability, contract obligations and volunteer support require judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise when a cheap repair or a routine request needs specialist or council review.
tasks.altitude: Less purchasing preparation with unchanged supervision and spending authority.

reach.task: Clarify a repair scope before supplier engagement
reach.learn: Service specifications, safe access and acceptance criteria

evidence.claim: Native purchasing forms can reuse routine supplier fields and order details while retaining human scope and terms checks.

assumptions: Boundary covers clergy administrative work, excluding supplier execution, specialist inspections, staff labour and council approvals beyond existing delegation. Shares represent a recurring mix, not every action on every occasion.

Clergy produces item or service need, quantity, site, desired date and constraints in s1 with full capture time retained. Suppliers produce quotations through their existing process; supplier IDs and quoted terms are entered and checked within retained s2 time. Missing or ambiguous details require manual clarification.
Test native purchasing forms first. No automatic supplier selection, acceptance of terms or transfer of council authority. Existing runtime earns no saving.
research_questions: Does saved-field preparation save time after scope and quotation checks?

already_counted.description: Capture quoted terms and resolve form exceptions

incremental.description: Maintain supplier form fields and templates

approvals.approved_version: Exact supplier, scope, quantity, site, date, price and terms checked within spending delegation before order; changes invalidate approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=90; gross 10 minus upkeep 2 gives net 8. High assumes repeat purchasing forms; low assumes unusual service terms consume gains. Inspection, commitment and supervision retain 80 hours.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Prepare approved fundraising materials and check the appeal purpose and event details
Participate in fundraising events and discuss congregational needs with supporters

tasks.design: Use approved campaign sections and native {DOCS} templates to prepare appeal materials. The clergy member checks the purpose and facts and retains all event participation and supporter conversations; no personalised donor targeting is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated adaptation and layout of established fundraising material.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing campaign kits provide reusable public material.
tasks.still_hard: Fundraising depends on trust, truthful explanation and respect for voluntary giving.
tasks.human_edge: Discuss needs without pressuring someone whose circumstances are unknown.
tasks.altitude: Less material assembly with unchanged participation and fundraising responsibility.

reach.task: Explain the appeal's approved use of funds
reach.learn: Restricted purposes and accurate public financial statements

evidence.claim: Actie Kerkbalans provides a campaign calendar, logos, social posts, banners and digital-giving material for annual church appeals.

assumptions: Boundary covers clergy preparation and participation, excluding campaign strategy, donor administration, accounting and mass mail distribution.

Council and treasurer supply the existing approved appeal purpose and financial facts; campaign owners supply reusable materials through their unchanged process. Clergy selects campaign version, purpose, event date and permitted public facts in s1; capture and accuracy checks remain within its 60% time. Missing facts require manual confirmation.
Test native reuse before custom generation. No new personal donor dataset, automatic messages or inferred ability to give. Existing runtime earns no saving.
unknowns: Campaign reuse rights and local approval process
Preparation share in actual fundraising activity
research_questions: Does approved material reuse save time after purpose and event-detail checks?

already_counted.description: Select campaign material and check local purpose and details

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=92; gross 8 less upkeep 2 gives net 6. High assumes reusable campaign materials; low assumes new local content consumes assembly gains. Fundraising participation retains 80 hours.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The clergy member keeps community relationships, oversight and authorised commitments while reducing repeated preparation.
reach: Work with treasurers, community coordinators and facilities colleagues on clear practical arrangements
role.ambitious_version: Support congregational activity with clearer administration and more time for human engagement.
